actualPackage.author: David Chanin <chanindav@gmail.com> (https://chanind.github.io/hanzi-writer)
actualPackage.description: The character data used by Hanzi Writer. This data is derived from the Make Me a Hanzi project.

modifications.aggregation: Three unchanged original UTF8 JSON files bundled into offline object; originals remain publicly available, glyph license unchanged. No binary font extraction or wrapping.
modifications.hexBranch: Unneeded unreviewed third-party HEX parser removed, unchanged RGB parser used with equivalent fixed RGB colors.

  showOutline: true,
  showCharacter: true,
  renderer: 'svg',

  width: 0,

  strokeAnimationSpeed: 1,
  strokeFadeDuration: 400,
  strokeHighlightDuration: 200,
  strokeHighlightSpeed: 2,
  delayBetweenStrokes: 1000,
